text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Elevated error-rate detected for /v1/stream (us-west-2). 5xx=11.3% over 10m (baseline 0.4%). Paging oncall.
Maya Patel: i'm live on the gateway dashboards. RPS spike from a handful of sessions causing heavy fanout. seeing lots of client cancels and incomplete chunk trailers.
Alex Chen: link to waterfall: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/streaming/waterfall?from=now-20m
Maya Patel: backend traces show upstream EOFs and 'chunked-trailer-missing' errors correlated with cancels
DevOps Bot: logs search: connection ids ctn-ef* show repeated client_cancel events
Samir Gupta: could be client SDK retry behavior combined with mid-stream cancels -> backend gets half-closed sockets and surfaces 502s. i'll try to repro with a focused replay.
Ryan O'Connor: i'm oncall for infra today. quick triage plan: 1) reduce per-session fanout concurrency 2) enable conservative circuit-breaker on gateway 3) suppress upstream 502 propagation when client-cancel observed 4) canary a code fix.
Maya Patel: can we set fanout_limit from 30 -> 8 in the hotspot region? that should stop the cascade.
Alex Chen: applying config change to cluster:gateway-us-west-2 -> session_fanout_limit=8. rolling across 4 nodes now.
Incident Bot: config rollout started by Alex Chen (roll id r-20260315-100)
Emma Li: CS: customers reporting truncated streams and partial content; opened customer tickets CS-3890, CS-3891. they're asking for ETA.
Samir Gupta: started a replay script: simultaneous clients start stream, then 400ms later send client-cancel. reproducing 502 spike locally.
Samir Gupta: repro snippet:
```
# pseudo flow
client -> gateway (starts stream)
client -> gateway (sends cancel)
gateway -> backend (flushing buffered chunks) -> backend returns error due to half-closed socket
gateway -> other fanout peers surface 502
```
Maya Patel: noticed KV cache thrash during the spike. evictions coincide with higher backend tail latencies, maybe amplifying errors.
Ryan O'Connor: temp mitigation: enable gateway connection-level CB threshold at 0.5 and increase stream read timeout from 25s -> 40s. this will give backend a bit more time to flush before treating as upstream error.
Alex Chen: toggles applied (cb=0.5, read_timeout=40s) in us-west-2. monitor link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/streaming/region/us-west-2
Maya Patel: within 3 minutes of fanout throttle + CB, 5xx fell to ~3.6%. good trend but still above baseline.
DevOps Bot: alert: if 5xx > 5% for 15m then page infra-sre-prod
Samir Gupta: quick code-level fix: treat client-cancel event as a non-fatal signal for fanout peers. will open branch and add tests.
Samir Gupta: git flow:
```
git checkout -b fix/suppress-cancel-propagation
# add unit + integration tests for cancel during chunked flush
```
Alex Chen: while Samir prepares patch, enable per-request flag 'suppress_upstream_on_cancel' = true as a short-lived safeguard.
Maya Patel: flag enabled. traffic shows client-cancel events still high, but 502 propagation dropped significantly. errors ~1.6% now.
Emma Li: CS updated customers: engineering deployed mitigations and working on a permanent fix. customers thanked us for quick response.
Samir Gupta: tests passing locally. pushing PR #547 to run CI. will canary deploy to two nodes once CI green.
Ryan O'Connor: canary strategy: deploy patch to 2 canaries in us-west-2, monitor 15m. if 5xx stays <1% and no regression, roll to region.
Incident Bot: canary deploy initiated by Samir Gupta (canary id c-20260315-02)
Maya Patel: 15m into canary: suppressed 502 logic working on canary nodes. per-request traces show fanout peers marked as 'cancelled' but no propagated 502.
Alex Chen: rolling patch to remaining nodes in region. patch includes extra debug fields: connection_id, fanout_count, last_chunk_seq for targeted logging in case of recurrence.
DevOps Bot: note: debug logging only enabled on canary and then disabled after roll to reduce noise.
Maya Patel: roll complete. region error-rate back to ~0.45% baseline. removing fanout throttle in 7 minutes.
Ryan O'Connor: keeping circuit-breaker settings for 2 hours as cautious measure. will hand off to night oncall with runbook notes.
Emma Li: drafting incident summary and customer impact note. will include timeline, mitigations, and next steps: unit tests, add metric for client_cancel->502 correlation, revisit default fanout limit, and a chaos test.
Samir Gupta: PR #547 merged and cherry-picked to release branch. will schedule a minor patch rollout to other regions tomorrow.
Maya Patel: post-incident TODOs: 1) add integration test for cancel+chunked-flush 2) create dashboard to track client_cancel->upstream_502 mapping 3) run targeted chaos test for fanout spikes 4) review SDK guidance to avoid aggressive client cancels.
Ryan O'Connor: handoff note for overnight: watch the 'streaming:client_cancel_to_502_ratio' metric. if ratio > 0.05 and 5xx >2% for 30m, page infra-sre-prod. keep CB enabled until 06:00 UTC.
Incident Bot: incident record created: incident_id=INC-20260315-fanout-cascade, severity=SEV3
Emma Li: great job everyone :heart: closing page if stable for 2h.
Maya Patel: thanks team. logging timeline and will sync with product/CS on customer comms.
